notes: Modeled as the Dante-equipped variant (base "DSQD"). A factory variant, "DSQD/AES3", replaces the two Dante RJ45 ports with two TA3M (mini-XLR3, male) jacks carrying AES3 digital audio instead — not modeled here as separate ports. Front panel also has a USB micro-B port (firmware update / Wireless Designer control, not bandwidth-graded in spec) and a bi-directional IR port (sync/setup, modeled as ir). Headphone jack is a 1/8 in (3.5mm) TRS monitor output. Antenna ports are RF antenna connectors (BNC, 50 ohm) rather than signal I/O in the AV sense, included for completeness with the closest connector id (bnc); no bandwidth grade applies. Dante ports are switched/daisy-chain ports (not independently addressable/redundant) — RJ45, Gigabit Ethernet confirmed by manufacturer spec sheet, graded eth-1g. Separate Ethernet control port (RJ45) is 10/100 class control-only per typical Lectrosonics control ports; manufacturer literature does not explicitly state its link speed, so grade omitted for that port to avoid an unconfirmed claim. Power inlet is a locking DC coaxial connector (7-18 VDC, 2.5A max per manufacturer spec); modeled as dc-barrel as the closest connector id since it's an external DC input rather than mains IEC.
